scope: Integrated Sugar Maple editor; QA-01 through QA-10 and Whiteboard canvas adoption
limitations: Chrome CPU flush timing is not frame time, input latency or cross-hardware evidence.
The Layers panel is not virtualized.
SwiftUI requires fixed sizing and explicitly rejects path/gradient/responsive export; no full visual-equivalence guarantee.
No arbitrary JavaScript/Swift library import or runtime, advanced typography/constraints, or network coediting was shipped.
Native package opening was verified through Open; Finder double-click association is not advertised.
The native build is a development build, not a notarized distribution.
preservation: Safety archive stays in ignored build storage. Actual native/MCP QA used its own bundle ID, document storage and port. Prior user app and its documents were not replaced.
